description: In front of the hands is a small round zen garden tray filled with white sand, with a tiny stacked-stone ornament and a smooth pebble inside, plus a small yellow rake. The left hand stays near the tray’s left edge without touching anything, while the right hand picks up the yellow rake and drags its teeth through the sand in short strokes, moving around the ornament and pebble to smooth and pattern the surface, then slightly lifts and repositions the rake for another pass.
